'''Veran Anjek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] cyborg [[Rattataki/Legends|Rattataki]] gladiator living during [[Galactic War]]. In [[3631 BBY]] he fought in the Grand Arena on [[Zakuul]] alongside [[Kordath]] and [[Calo Arawan]] against [[Bowdaar]] and [[Alliance Commander|the Alliance Commander]], in a match arranged by [[Valdos Dofine]]. Veran Anjek's side lost the fight and all three were killed in the match.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Veran Anjek appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during Bowdaar Alliance alert mission.
